sentences.text: The applicant is in custody since 12.12.2025.

3] The allegation against the applicant is of threatening the witness to compromise the matter, as admittedly, the applicant was earlier involved in a case of rape against the complainant in connection with Crime No.551/2024 registered at Police Station Vijay Nagar, District Indore (MP)
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-IND:3007 2 MCRC-59688-2025 for offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(2) (F) and 506 of the IPC and Section 5(l) and 6 of the POCSO Act, 2012, in which, the applicant has already been granted bail by this Court vide order 4.8.2025 dated passed in MCRC.No.12848/2025.

4] Counsel for the applicant has submitted that after the applicant was released on bail, he is regularly attending the Court, and prior to the last date of hearing a scene was also created by the Dashrath Vishwakarma vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 30 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/126342903/
1 prosecutrix in the trial Court itself, and on the same day an FIR was lodged alleging the threat extended by the applicant to the complainant to take the case back.

sentences.text: It is further submitted that the applicant was present in the Court on 11.11.2025, and he remained in the Court till 4.30 PM, and thereafter he also visited the office of his counsel, where he remained till 7.30 PM, whereas the time of the incident is 3.00 PM, in the noon, thus, it is submitted that the application be allowed as the FIR has been lodged by malafide intention.

5] Counsel for the applicant has also submitted that the applicant is lodged in jail since 12.12.2025 and the conclusion of trial will take sufficiently long time, thus, it is prayed that the application be allowed.
6] Counsel for the State has opposed the prayer.

7] Having considered the rival submissions and on perusal of the case-diary, as also the FIR lodged by the victim and the earlier order passed by this Court in MCRC.No.12848 of 2025, which was also allowed on the ground, that the prosecutrix is not appearing in the trial court, in view of the same,
this Court is inclined to allow the present application.

8] Accordingly, without commenting on the merits of the case, the NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2026:MPHC-IND:3007 3 MCRC-59688-2025 application filed by the applicant is hereby allowed.

The applicant is directed to be released on bail upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his/her regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he / she shall remain present before the court concerned during trial and shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
9] Accordingly, the application is allowed and disposed of.
